regime.headline: Nifty 50 DMA ke upar hai par signal kamzor: A half size, B skip.

plan.entry_rule: Trigger candle ke high ke upar buy-stop
plan.stop_rule: Pullback low ya 1.5× ATR, jo neeche ho (pullback low)
plan.trail: Baaki 10 EMA ke neeche daily close pe trail
notes: Swing high ₹934.90 target se pehle resistance hai

sizing.rule: Capital ka 0.5% risk, position max 25% capital

hourly.label: Downtrend
hourly.detail: Hourly abhi neeche ja raha: trigger ka intezaar karo

checks.label: Swing high se 3-8 din ka pullback
20 EMA (3% ke andar) ya purane breakout level pe
Pullback mein volume 20-din avg se kam
Pullback mein 50 DMA ke neeche close nahi

plan.entry_rule: Reversal candle ke high ke upar buy-stop
plan.stop_rule: Reversal candle ya haal ke swing low ke neeche, jo neeche ho
plan.trail: Trail mat karo: mean tak aate hi edge khatam
notes: Half size. Average down kabhi nahi.

sizing.rule: Capital ka 0.5% risk, position max 15% capital

hourly.label: Uptrend
hourly.detail: Hourly chart 20 EMA ke upar wapas aaya (entry ke liye achha)

checks.label: 3-5 din lagatar girawat ya 5 din mein 6-12% gira
50/200 DMA support pe
